title: Private deployment: config entropy causing operator upgrade skews — emergency fallback and hotpatch
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Several customers running Private/VPC deployments reported failed operator upgrades after a recent Helm chart bump. Symptoms varied across clusters: operator Pods stuck in CrashLoopBackOff, helm release status 'pending-upgrade' with partial CRD application, control-plane webhooks timing out, and nodes reporting compute pressure leading to image GC during install. The common thread is a subtle config skew introduced by a migration that added an optional nodeSelector and an initContainer that manipulates a per-node annotation. When combined with older on-prem kubelet churn and delayed webhook cert rotation, the operator enters an inconsistent state where finalizers remain and helm upgrades cannot complete. This ticket coordinates the emergency fallback tool, a targeted hotpatch build, customer notifications, and the automation to detect 'config entropy' (divergent config patches across nodes) before upgrades.

actions_taken: Created a safe_finalizer_cleaner utility (kubectl job) to idempotently remove orphaned finalizers when operator reconciler is unreachable
Published rollback playbook and automated chart revert script to customer-facing runbook (link: drive/release-playbooks/private-rollback-2026-03-10)
Built v2.7.1-hotfix: fixes include defensive CRD apply order, exponential webhook retry with jitter, and a node annotation validation pre-check
Deployed canary to internal staging and to three pilot customer clusters; verified canary passes upgrade & downgrade paths
Added a k8s agent script that computes per-node config entropy and fails fast before starting an upgrade if entropy > threshold
Notified affected customers with mitigation steps and SLA credits where appropriate; customer success leads engaged
next_steps: Complete security review for hotfix (coordinate with Security by 2026-03-16)
Automate the config entropy detection as a pre-upgrade gate in the onprem operator upgrade flow
Hardening: add integration test that simulates delayed webhook cert rotation and node churn during upgrades
Ship v2.7.1-hotfix to all remaining affected clusters progressively with canary window and rollback hooks
Postmortem and permanent remediation plan: document RCA, update upgrade docs, and schedule follow-up epics for operator resiliency
